city.title: Riyadh

ramada.name: The Old Capital
ramada.hotel: Ramada by Wyndham Riyadh, King Fahd Road
ramada.vibe: A 24-floor tower on King Fahd Road, a short ride from the palaces of old Riyadh.

bab-samhan.name: The Heritage Village
bab-samhan.hotel: Bab Samhan, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Diriyah
bab-samhan.vibe: Mud-brick courtyards in Diriyah, a walk away from At-Turaif.

comfort-olaya.name: The Skyline District

national-museum.name: The National Museum
national-museum.desc: The history of Arabia, from its first settlements to the founding of the Kingdom.

murabba-palace.name: Murabba Historical Palace
murabba-palace.desc: A mud-brick palace with vintage royal cars in its grounds.

darah.name: King Abdulaziz Darah

masmak.name: Al Masmak Palace Museum

marthad.name: Marthad Specialty Coffee
marthad.desc: Specialty coffee, a short walk from the hotel.

illume.name: illume Café and Roastery
illume.desc: A café that roasts its own beans.

bygone-years.name: Museum of Bygone Years
bygone-years.desc: An old Saudi house, kept as it was.

turaif-viewpoint.name: At-Turaif Viewpoint

the-warehouse.name: The Warehouse
the-warehouse.desc: A live music venue in a converted warehouse.

bohemia.name: Bohemia Café and Records
bohemia.desc: Coffee and a record shop under one roof.

jax-01.name: Jax 01
jax-01.desc: The main gallery hall of JAX District.

sky-bridge.name: Kingdom Centre Sky Bridge
sky-bridge.desc: The bridge across the top of Kingdom Centre, with the whole city below.

mamlaka-social.name: Al Mamlaka Social Dining
mamlaka-social.desc: A food hall inside Kingdom Centre.

the-roof.name: The Roof at Al Mamlaka
the-roof.desc: Dining on the roof of Al Mamlaka.

al-faisaliah.name: Al Faisaliah Tower

morfi.name: MORFi
morfi.desc: Specialty coffee next door to the hotel.

goat.name: GOAT by REEHAM
goat.desc: Coffee around the corner from the hotel.

jax.name: JAX District
